/ Concerning the Dragon with Fourte[en] He[ads]; / what it is and [ ... ] /
Many Manichaean texts describe the human body as a microcosmos full of warring demons. Interestingly, here Mani asserts that this is a spiritual but not a physical truth. He proceeds to relate the fourteen headed dragon in the body, with its five refuges, to different parts of the anatomy. The dragon is really the driving force or 'thought' of the body that the righteous person must overcome, so as to receive the victory.
